name: Fushimi Angelia
original_name: 伏見 アンジェリア
source:
Affectionately known as "An," Angelia is a senior nurse to Hibari and one of Keita's attending nurses. She's a Japanese-English half and was raised in Japan. With her bright and friendly personality, she's trusted by everyone.

Angelia has high standards for romantic relationships, and she spreads the word that she has a boyfriend to fend off unwanted advances, but in truth, she's a virgin. "I've decided to give all of myself to the man I determine is 'the one'," she confides only to Keita.

That's because Angelia has some interest in Keita, a young prodigy from a top-tier university who seems to have a bright future. Although she's generally supportive of Keita, she isn't averse to making her own audacious moves when the circumstances call for it.
